title: Model vetting playbook, version pinning policy, and profile release gates
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Establish a repeatable, auditable playbook for onboarding third-party and open-source models that combines automated license and weights screening with human review thresholds, formal version-pinning guidance for customers, and gating rules for publishing performance profiles. The goal is to prevent restricted or incompatible-licensed weights from being served, ensure provenance is captured for audit, and avoid publishing misleading performance profiles before compliance checks complete.
steps: Define automated pre-checks: license classification, model hash verification, weight source signature check, and restricted-weights blocklist lookup
Specify human-review thresholds: confidence score cutoffs for license classifier, detected provenance gaps, and flagged tokenization or architecture mismatches
Design version-pinning policy: default pin-to-major-minor, recommendations for patch updates, and customer notification workflow for model upgrades
Create gating rules for publishing performance profiles: require all compliance checks green, at least one full-run perf benchmark on pinned version, and a test-eval pass for safety regressions
Implement metadata capture: canonical model identifier, source URL, commit/weights hash, license text snapshot, and custody chain in provenance field
Wire audit logs and approver trail into Console: who approved, timestamp, reason for override, and link to evidence
Define remediation actions: quarantine, rollback to pinned version, takedown request flow, and communication templates for affected customers
Integrate with Developer Portal: model catalog flags (compliant, restricted, review-required) and public-facing guidance on pinning best practices
acceptance_criteria: Automated pre-checks run on every onboarding submission and generate a deterministic report stored with model metadata
Models that fail automated checks land in a 'review-required' queue visible to reviewers in Console
Human reviewers can approve, reject, or request more info; all actions recorded with audit log entries
Published performance profiles are blocked until compliance status is 'compliant' and a pinned version has benchmark artifacts attached
A documented version-pinning recommendation is published to DevDocs and surfaced in the model catalog UI
At least one end-to-end test demonstrates a restricted-weight sample being flagged and quarantined end-to-end (auto-check -> review -> reject)

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: License classifier false negatives may permit problematic models. Mitigation: conservative thresholds and mandatory manual review for unknown/low-confidence results.
Risk: Slower onboarding due to manual reviews. Mitigation: SLAs for reviewers, escalation path, and improved classifier over time; provide provisional 'reviewing' badge to early adopters.
Risk: Customers pinning to insecure older weights. Mitigation: publish recommended update cadence and vulnerability notices tied to version metadata.
